comments: I just found that regression was in 5.10.1

review_comments: Mmm i have the feeling this will not work here since `is_global_block` will be populated during the analyze walk. This might mean the it will only work with certain orders. Will explore this a bit
Oh but this will be invoked only after we already set that to true.
Should I change it to use `is_global_block_selector()` to not depend on analyze step (which set global flag to metadata)?
Nope that checks if a node is the global selector, you want to check if you are inside...i think it should work
